flagged.title: Exam Timing & Strategy
flagged.reason: The entire video is built around an incorrect 25-minute timing allocation (3/12/3/7) and advising only 2 comparison paragraphs, whereas Eduqas allocates 60 minutes (4/16/5/35) with 4 comparison paragraphs.

mark_affecting.quote: You have exactly 25 minutes for the unseen poetry section... Minutes 0 to 3, you read poem 1 three times and annotate. Minutes 3 to 15, you are writing part 1. Then minutes 15 to 18, you pivot, read poem 2... minutes 18 to 25, you write part 2.

mark_affecting.video_says: just two developed paragraphs comparing the poems. That is it.
mark_affecting.lesson_says: Write Part (ii) — 4 developed paragraphs comparing both poems... Default Part (ii) structure: Paragraphs 1–2 (compare a technique from each poem), Paragraph 3 (compare structure), Paragraph 4 (compare tone or the endings).
